name: Modern SEO - M1L4 How We Do Local SEO
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 1 Foundation and Diagnosis](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-1-foundation-and-diagnosis) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
The agency roadmap (3:43). Measurement comes first; the rank map is the "North Star." Every client starts with the three steps, then trust links, then Core 30 if needed, then geographic relevance. Each phase builds on the last.

# Roadmap steps
1. Set up a rank map running every other week for primary category + city, before changing anything.
2. GBP audit and fix.
3. GBP landing page audit and fix.
4. Source quality citations.
5. Join the local Chamber of Commerce ("a high-quality local authority link").
6. Check the rank map. Below the green target, source 1 to 2 high-trust local links per month (course Prompt Library has a prompt for finding them).
7. Still below target: start Core 30 (a page for every GBP category and service, linked to mirror the GBP).
8. At the target: shift to geographic relevance (content about all service areas).
9. Give every new content page "a decent link" to help it get indexed.
10. Keep sourcing 1 to 2 high-trust local links per month throughout. Repeat until the map is green across the target area.

# Key concepts
- **Green target:** audio says "20, 30, 40% depending on the size of the city"; slides say 30 to 40%.
- **Order matters:** no advanced content until fundamentals are handled; no geographic expansion until topical relevance is strong.

# Notable quotes
- "The foundation of everything we do is measurement."
- "This rank map becomes our North Star."

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Confirm a rank map runs every other week on primary category + city for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub). If TAG has no grid rank tool, flag it to Kim rather than signing up (check [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) first).
- Place each client on the roadmap (three steps, local links, Core 30, geographic) by green percentage to set the next task.
- TAG's standing link plan (2 press releases per month and $50 per month per client in backlinks via Search Atlas, per Kim's memory) is not the same as 1 to 2 high-trust local links; Kim may want to check whether current links are local.
- Check Chamber of Commerce membership and listing link per client (membership costs money, needs approval).
- Links for indexing support the Alphalete indexing fix (see [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker)).
- The end-goal example slide shows a Phoenix metro map, a useful picture for Summit AZ's market (not identified as any client).

# Caveats and open questions
- Green target conflict with no rule for which city size gets which number.
- "Decent link" is not defined. The Prompt Library prompt is not shown; it must be downloaded from the course.
